title: NOMOS Decision
description: A single declarative governance decision within a .nomos artifact's logic.decisions array (NOMOS-SPEC-001 §4)

id.description: Unique decision identifier within this artifact

description.description: Natural-language description of the decision, derived from the source policy

when.description: Nomos-Expr v1 condition string (§4.1) — e.g. "invoice_amount > 25000", "always == true". NOT a condition-tree object.

then.description: Outcomes applied when `when` evaluates true, in order

else.description: Outcomes applied when `when` evaluates false. MAY be empty

priority.description: Higher value = evaluated first when multiple decisions are eligible (§3.6 logic.resolution)

valid_from.description: ISO 8601 UTC — decision is inactive before this instant. Half-open interval: [valid_from, valid_until). NOMOS-SPEC-003 §3.

valid_until.description: ISO 8601 UTC — decision is inactive at and after this instant. Half-open interval. NOMOS-SPEC-003 §3.

provenance.description: Traceability back to the source document this decision was derived from. RECOMMENDED for every decision derived from a document.

escalation_id.description: REQUIRED for type: escalate — references governance.escalations[].id (§3.7)

action_name.description: REQUIRED for type: action — references execution.actions (§3.8)

event.description: For type: emit — the event recorded; "classify" records a classification (amendment 2.5.0 §4.3)

payload.description: For type: emit. With event "classify": the classification and its legal relations (amendment 2.5.0 §4.3, §4.7)

definition.description: The provisions within which the classifications of this variable carrying it are every way the status arises; closes the definition (§4.7.3)

overrides.description: Ids of the other classifications of the same variable this one sets aside (§4.7.1)
